title: Resilience learning observations
description: Draft, definitions-only extraction of the attached SQL's emotional-coaching tracking and progress-metric ideas. This schema is not a database model, storage authorization, runtime integration, clinical instrument, or evidence-verification contract. It defines alternative record shapes, not a combined learner profile.

optionalObservationText.description: Brief, non-identifying description. Null means not observed, not known, or intentionally omitted; do not infer a negative finding from null. Do not include names, locations, diagnoses, private disclosures, or identifying events. Length limits do not guarantee privacy; review text before any authorized sharing.

coachingObservation.title: Optional private coaching observation
coachingObservation.description: An optional educational reflection, not surveillance or a diagnostic baseline. Record what was noticed without inferring a child's internal state. Use only when safe and voluntary; pause or stop if recording increases pressure, conflict, or risk. Do not collect identifiers or require uploading a child's log. No persistence or sharing is authorized by this definition.

day_index.description: Relative day within an optional 14-day practice window; not a date, timestamp, or requirement to record every day.

examples.support_offered: Offered a quieter space and a choice about when to continue.
examples.what_seemed_helpful: The quieter space seemed helpful; the cause of distress is not known.

progressMetric.title: Descriptive caregiver practice count
progressMetric.description: A self-reported count of caregiver practice over a stated observation window, not proof of change, a child outcome, a validated score, or a parenting-capacity finding. Counts are not comparable across families or unequal observation periods and must not determine passing, readiness, or access to services. Missing or intentionally omitted information is null, not zero. Zero is used only when the reporter observed no instances of the defined action.

metric.description: support_offered_count: distinct occasions when the caregiver offered listening, space, practical assistance, or another agreed support. reflective_check_in_count: occasions when the caregiver privately reviewed their own response, without requiring child disclosure. adult_follow_through_count: occasions when the caregiver carried out a specific supportive commitment they had made. Count each occasion once within each metric; different metrics may describe the same occasion and must not be summed into a score. Do not count child compliance, speed of calming, forced reconciliation, or disclosure.

observation_window_days.description: Length of the self-reported practice window, not the number of days with complete observations.

source.description: These draft definitions cover educational self-report only; they do not represent practitioner verification or independently observed evidence.

limitations.description: Non-identifying notes on gaps, recall uncertainty, context, or reasons the count cannot establish change. No names, diagnoses, or private child details.

examples.limitations: Recalled examples only; observation was incomplete. This does not establish a trend, effectiveness, or child outcome.
Not recorded; no inference should be made about practice or progress.
